notes: Covers Oracle-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including basic remote object references, synonym statements, explain plan statements, national string literals, national q-quoted strings, session-state statements, and single-target INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE RETURNING INTO colon-prefixed host-bind result sinks. All 217 cases have status = "final". Vastbase-only Oracle extensions are tracked separately when official syntax requires behavior beyond the shared AST.

Covers MySQL-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including backtick identifiers, national string literals, parameterized LIMIT, CTE, window-function, scalar-function, common-type, ROLLBACK, SELECT alias lineage, MySQL INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE modifier cases, REPLACE base forms, CREATE TABLE column attributes, table options, partition tails, index-hint placement, and session-state statements.
Covers PostgreSQL-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including national string literals and session-state statements.

Covers SQL Server-compatible syntax through an explicit Vastbase mode, including TOP PERCENT/WITH TIES, nested TOP, FOR JSON suffix restoration, table/query hint public restoration, bitwise expressions, !</!> comparisons, pipe concatenation, LIKE bracket wildcards, AT TIME ZONE, IS DISTINCT FROM, OR predicate lineage, basic SET statements, session-state statements, basic CONNECT BY, and basic forms of mixed-model official entries. START WITH, PRIOR, NOCYCLE, and CONNECT_BY_ROOT are outside this mode's current boundary.
